title: IS THERE NO BALM
IN GILEAD
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: tranquil turquoise living waters river stream
warm golden sanctuary light filtering through trees
gentle white dove resting in peaceful olive branches
soft morning mist over calm turquoise waters
golden sunlight breaking through morning clouds
tranquil turquoise sea waves gently lapping shore
serene sanctuary interior with warm golden glow

scenes.a: If this lingering ache leaves you wondering where healing is found, stay right here.
Lord, we bring every persistent weariness and unspoken hurt into your presence today.
We acknowledge the deep questions we carry when restoration feels so distant.
Your word asks us directly, saying, Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there?
Why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
Father, touch our lives with your restoring grace and bind up every broken place.
Grant us quiet trust in your enduring mercy, in Jesus name, amen.
